title_en: LNJ Foxwoods Co-Founder Larry Roth Dies at 75
description: Larry Roth co-founded Marchon Eyewear that he and his partners sold in 2008. The Roths started LNJ Foxwoods in 2012 and enjoyed tremendous success as both owner and breeder.

title_en: Xtra Heat Trainer Salzman Sr. Dies at 81
description: John Salzman Sr., a stalwart of Maryland Thoroughbred racing for decades who trained Hall of Famer Xtra Heat, died Sept. 28 at age 81.

title_en: Court of Appeals Rules Against Prediction Market Site
description: In a win for horse racing interests, the United States Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that prediction market platform Kalshi is operating in violation of two bodies of law by taking bets on sporting events.

title_en: Magniers Secure Minnie Hauk's Half Sister at Goffs Orby
description: The half sister to Minnie Hauk lived up to her star billing at the Goffs Orby Sale Book 1, selling to Coolmore's M.V. Magnier in front of a packed auditorium Sept. 28. The daughter of Justify will follow a similar path to her illustrious sibling.

title_en: Forever Young Tops Breeders' Cup Classic Future Wager
description: Susumu Fujita's 2025 Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) and 2026 Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1) winner, Forever Young, closed as the 5-2 favorite upon the completion of betting Sept. 27 in Pool No. 2 of the Breeders' Cup Classic Future Wager.

title_en: BH Monday: Forged Steel Triumphs in Goodwood
description: On the Sept. 28 episode of BloodHorse Monday: C2 Racing Stable's Mark Cornett discusses Forged Steel's victory in the Goodwood Stakes (G1), Frank Angst on the ripple effects of Hawthorne's bankruptcy.

title_en: Gagliano to Retire as Jockey Club President, COO
description: James L. Gagliano will retire as president and chief operating officer of The Jockey Club effective Jan. 1, 2027, it was announced Sept. 28 by Everett R. Dobson, chair of The Jockey Club.

title_en: Champion Winx Produces Filly by Too Darn Hot
description: The daughter of Too Darn Hot was born early last week at Coolmore's Hunter Valley and she has already been exploring her new home.

title_en: Leading West Virginia Sire Fiber Sonde Dies at 21
description: Fiber Sonde, an unraced son of Unbridled's Song and a half brother to champion sprinter Speightstown, was West Virginia's general leading sire from 2018-23.

title_en: Highfield to Acquire Century Downs, Century Mile Tracks
description: Highfield Investment Group also owns a 1,000-acre breeding and racing farm called Highfield Stock Farm.

title_en: Marnane Appointed Chairperson of the BUCA
description: Amy Marnane has been appointed chairperson of the Breeze-Up Consignors Association, succeeding Brendan Holland after 11 years in the role. Marnane will be supported by Thomond O'Mara of Knockanglass Stables, who takes over as vice chairman.

title_en: Keeneland's 90th Fall Meet Opens Oct. 2
description: Keeneland will welcome many of the world's top horses and competitors to Lexington beginning Oct. 2 for a spectacular month of Thoroughbred racing that celebrates the track's 90th anniversary and culminates with the Breeders' Cup World Championships.

title_en: Silent Tactic Edges Zihnal in Oklahoma Derby
description: Silent Tactic brushed off his huge loss in the $1.25 million Travers Stakes (G1) in late August to run one of the best races of his life to win the $400,000 Oklahoma Derby (G3) Sept. 27 at Remington Park.

title_en: Fasig-Tipton Kentucky October Yearlings Catalog Online
description: Fasig-Tipton has cataloged 1,615 entries for its Kentucky October Yearlings Sale, to be held Oct.19-22 in Lexington. The four continuous sessions, conducted Monday-Thursday, will begin each day at 10 a.m. ET.

title_en: Global Symposium on Racing Brings Ideas Together
description: For more than half a century, the University of Arizona's Global Symposium on Racing has operated on a relatively simple premise: Horse racing works better when the people shaping its future talk to one another.

title_en: Realize Sirius Among 3-Year-Olds in Mainichi Okan
description: Racing returns at Tokyo Racecourse this weekend for the first time since June 21 and features the Oct. 4 Mainichi Okan (G2) over 1,800 meters (about 1 1/8 miles), one of the most important prep races for the Tenno Sho Autumn (G1) Nov. 1 at Tokyo.

title_en: Champion Super Corredora Returns With Zenyatta Win
description: Last year's champion 2-year-old filly, in her first race since March, captured the Zenyatta Stakes at Santa Anita and earned a berth into the Breeders' Cup Distaff.

title_en: Fire and Wine Embarrasses Rivals in Breeders' Stakes
description: With jockey Jalon Samuel perfectly executing a frontrunning ride, Fire and Wine took the final jewel of the Canadian Triple Crown Sept. 27 in the $353,539 Breeders' Stakes at Woodbine.

title_en: Trainer Ruis Charged With Navy Contracting Fraud
description: Owner and trainer Mick Ruis Sr. is one of three scaffolding executives indicted by San Diego federal prosecutors for allegedly conspiring to defraud the U.S. by using deceptive tactics to secure construction contracts with the U.S. Navy.

title_en: Shisospicy Training Up to Breeders' Cup Defense
description: Morplay Racing's 4-year-old filly Shisospicy, last year's champion female sprinter, continues to train forwardly for a planned return trip to the Breeders' Cup.

title_en: Belmont Winner Sir Winston Sires First Winner in Canada
description: Belmont Stakes (G1) winner and Crestwood Farm first-crop stallion Sir Winston was represented by his first winner Sept. 27 when West Side Lily won the B Cup 2 Year Olds Stakes in the opening race at Rocky Mountain Turf Club in Lethbridge, Alberta.

title_en: Weekend Santa Anita Turf Winners Target Breeders' Cup
description: Winners of Sept. 26 graded stakes are targeting starts in the Breeders' Cup, including Cabo Spirit, Sorrento Sky, and Bishops Bay.

title_en: Jimmysstar Returns to Winning Ways in Manikato
description: In what proved to be a hugely memorable Sunday's racing at Caulfield for trainer Ciaron Maher Sept. 27, stable favorite Jimmysstar produced a stellar come-from-behind effort to land a big victory in the AU$2 million Manikato Stakes (G1).

title_en: Goliath Wins Third Group 1 in Preis von Europa
description: Resolute Bloodstock and Philip Baron Von Ullmann's Goliath added another group 1 to his brilliant CV as he emphatically returned to winning ways in the Preis von Europa (G1) Sept. 27 at Cologne in Germany.

title_en: Elite Bloodlines Up For Grabs at Goffs Orby Sale Book 1
description: The 482-lot catalog contains siblings to 22 group 1 winners. Chief among these is the Justify half sister to Minnie Hauk (Lot 154), who topped the 2023 Orby at €1,850,000 before landing the Oaks (G1), as well as the Irish and Yorkshire equivalents.

title_en: Warwoven Dominant in Golden Rose Triumph
description: Warwoven provided a huge success for both connections of him and his sire when he scored an utterly dominant win in the Sept. 26 Golden Rose Stakes (G1) at Rosehill Gardens Racecourse.

title_en: TCA Celebrates Breeder Goodman as Honor Guest
description: Noting his commitment to the Thoroughbred and the land, the Thoroughbred Club of America recognized owner-breeder H. Greg Goodman as its Honor Guest at its 95th testimonial dinner Sept. 26 at Keeneland.

title_en: Puro Magic Grabs First G1 Win in Sprinters Stakes
description: Puro Magic led from the start in the Sprinters Stakes (G1) Sept. 27 at Nakayama Racecourse and held on at the end to score her first grade 1 win.

title_en: Atitlan Rallies to Seize John Henry Turf Championship
description: Atitlan rallies strongest of all in the final quarter of the Sept. 26 John Henry Turf Championship Stakes (G2T) to post a clear 2 1/4-length victory at Santa Anita Park.

title_en: Forged Steel Earns Classic Entry After Winning Goodwood
description: After crushing the field in the Hollywood Gold Cup Stakes (G2) in late May, Forged Steel returns Sept. 26 to Santa Anita Park and wins once again, this time in the Goodwood Stakes (G1).

title_en: Cabo Spirit, Sorrento Sky, Little Opal Win Stakes in CA
description: As the longest shot on the board, Cabo Spirit leads throughout to capture the City of Hope Mile Stakes (G2T) and earn an automatic berth to the Breeders' Cup Mile (G1T). Sorrento Sky rallies to take the Eddie D Stakes (G2T).

title_en: Dragoon Guard Storms Home in Lukas Classic Stakes
description: Dragoon Guard rolls by 3 1/4 lengths in taking the Lukas Classic Stakes (G2) Sept. 26 at Churchill Downs and gives jockey Tyler Gaffalione his sixth winner on the day.

title_en: Mastering a Mile: Bishops Bay Takes Ack Ack
description: Some horses can leave their trainers scratching their heads, wondering which type of race suits them best. Then there's one as easy to grasp as Bishops Bay, who is now 5-2-0 in seven starts at a mile after winning the Sept. 26 Ack Ack Stakes (G3).

title_en: Sadler Sees 'Mental Freshness' in Super Corredora
description: Reigning 2-year-old filly champion Super Corredora returns Sept. 27 in the Zenyatta Stakes (G2) at Santa Anita Park. "What I see in her is a mental freshness. Her brain seems happier having had some time off from the grind," trainer John Sadler says.

title_en: Breeders' Cup Possible for Haffner With Royal Lodge Win
description: The Breeders' Cup, the Two Thousand Guineas (G1), and the Prix du Jockey Club (French Derby, G1) were all mentioned in the aftermath of Haffner's authoritative victory in the Sept. 26 Royal Lodge Stakes (G2) at Newmarket Racecourse.

title_en: Orthodox Bounces Back to Grab Middle Park Stakes
description: Trainer Clive Cox and owner Jason Goddard muscled their way past Aidan O'Brien and the Coolmore partners and into the spotlight thanks to the victory by Orthodox in the Middle Park Stakes (G1) Sept. 26 at Newmarket Racecourse.

title_en: Washington Owner, Breeder Hagen Dies at Age 81
description: Owner and breeder Ron Hagen died Sept. 12 in Kent, Wash. He was 81.

title_en: Half Siblings Give Bakers Two Breeders' Cup Hopes
description: Connie and Jerry Baker bred Vodka Vodka and Om N Joy, half siblings looking for "Win and You're In" Breeders' Cup berths in upcoming Santa Anita Park stakes.

title_en: Leading Florida Sire First Dude Dies at 19
description: The Double Diamond Farm homebred was a grade 1 winner as a racehorse and topped the Florida sire standings in 2018. His top performers include 2018 Eclipse champion female sprinter Shamrock Rose.

title_en: Rated by Merit Retired From Racing, Joins Ocala Stud
description: St. Elias Stable's homebred Rated by Merit has been retired from racing. The son of Battalion Runner will enter stud next year at Ocala Stud in Florida for a $3,500 fee.

title_en: Classic Winner, Pensioned Stallion Red Bullet has Died
description: Red Bullet, who upset 2000 Kentucky Derby (G1) winner Fusaichi Pegasus in the Preakness Stakes (G1), died Aug. 7 in Ocala, Fla., according to a report from Horse Racing Nation.

title_en: IFHA to Look Back, Ahead at Milestone Conference
description: The IFHA will both reflect on major achievements across six decades and focus on racing's future when it gathers for the 60th International Conference of Horseracing Authorities Oct. 5 at Le Méridien Paris Arc de Triomphe in Paris, France.

title_en: Not This Time Widens Margin in Leading Sire Race
description: The successes of recent graded stakes winners Bodacious Bay and Conceit brings Not This Time's total of 2026 stakes winners to 22, of which 13 are graded scorers.

title_en: Debuting Winners Fiora, Mystic Ride Named Hot Prospects
description: Pricey juveniles Fiora and Mystic Ride are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after registering maiden victories on debut at Belmont Park and Los Alamitos Race Course, respectively.

title_en: From Pucks to Paddock, Hockey's Noticeable Influence
description: This week's The List looks at some of the ways hockey has infiltrated the Thoroughbred industry. There may be no better example than leading sire Nyquist.

title_en: Sun Kissed Bliss is Mind Control's First Stakes Winner
description: Bred and raced by Top Line Sales' Torie Gladwell, Sun Kissed Bliss becomes a stakes winner in her second career start and has now earned $123,630.

title_en: Miracle Michael Echoes Determination of Cancer Survivor
description: New York-bred named after owner's grandson, who in his first year was diagnosed in both eyes with retinoblastoma, a type of eye cancer that starts as a growth of cells in the retina.

title_en: Caroline St. Beat 'Everything' Goichman Ever Dreamed of
description: Why it Worked: Breeder Lawrence Goichman reaping the benefits of breeding multiple generations of the family of Caroline St. Beat.

title_en: Cajun Caviar First Stakes Winner for LA Sire No Parole
description: Ellen Epstein's Cajun Caviar improves to 2-for-2 by capturing the Louisiana Cup Juvenile Fillies Stakes Sept. 19 at Louisiana Downs, becoming the first stakes winner for her sire No Parole.

title_en: Reza Romps, Becomes First Winner for Tale of Silence
description: Reza turned heads by breaking his maiden by 8 lengths with a last-to-first rally in his debut Sept. 19 at Gulfstream Park, becoming the first winner for freshman sire Tale of Silence.

title_en: Half to In Our Time Set for Keeneland Sales Ring
description: When Laura's Pleasure was paired with Oscar Performance, it caught the attention of Neal Clarke of Bedouin Bloodstock. Then he got a look at their bay colt, which he is consigning Sept. 19 as Hip 1459 at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

title_en: Baeza, Further Ado to Join Spendthrift Roster in 2027
description: Spendthrift Farm will add grade 1 winners Baeza and Further Ado to its stallion roster for the 2027 breeding season.

title_en: Stone Farm Founder, Industry Shaper Hancock Dies at 83
description: Arthur Hancock III, who soared to the heights of Thoroughbred racing and breeding and is enshrined in the Racing Hall of Fame as a Pillar of the Turf, died Sept. 18 at his home near Paris, Ky., according to a family member. He was 83.

title_en: Up to the Mark Leads First-Crop Sires at Keeneland
description: The son of Not This Time, who stands at Lane's End, is the only first-year sire with a seven-figure yearling thus far at the Keeneland September sale, and is also the only member of his crop to crack the top 10 sires by average.

title_en: Shotgun Hottie Euthanized After Beginning to Founder
description: Graded stakes-winning millionaire Shotgun Hottie, less than a couple of years into her broodmare career, was euthanized this past weekend after beginning to founder, said Case Clay, racing manager for owner Wathnan Racing.

title_en: Antiquarian Sold, Will Stand at Japan's Arrow Stud
description: Owner Centennial Farms, which campaigned Antiquarian, announced Sept. 18 that the grade 1-winning son of the late Preservationist has been sold to JS Company and Directors to begin his stallion career at Arrow Stud in Japan.
